text:
<subject>Re: Lumière Santé Cover Letter & Resume for Édouard Guillaume</subject>
<body>
Thibaut, thanks for your very prompt email response. I passed your message along to Sébastien.

Thanks also for a great dinner and day of meetings last week. I really enjoyed the chance to learn more about Lumière Santé, and was very impressed with everyone I met.

Look forward to working with you these next few months!!

Cheers,
Thibaut Pons
Coordinator
Lumière Santé SAS
+33 4 72 34 56 78
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr
Sent: mercredi 15 janvier 2025 14:39
To: thibaut.pons@lumieresante.fr
Cc: aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr
Subject: Re: Lumière Santé Cover Letter & Resume for Édouard Guillaume



Thibaut,

I have forwarded the resume to our Clinique des Îles pool with
a recommendation to accept Sébastien as a summer intern.

I expressed interest in taking him into my group, Clinical Operations. He may, of course, work for a different unit of Lumière Santé. It's up to him and I shall not be offended if he would like to go into healthcare services or medical research.

Thibaut
</quoted>
